summary: BBVA, via a Form 6-K, updates on the third tranche of its share buyback program (Third Tranche). The filing discloses that between 15-19 June 2026, the program manager (Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG) purchased BBVA shares for a cumulative €791.6 million, representing ~54.22% of the tranche's maximum cash amount. Per EU Market Abuse Regulation, BBVA reports these transactions. The buyback reduces outstanding share count, enhancing return of capital. This is an issuer tender/ capital return, not a merger or special committee review. Watch: execution pace and any capacity to complete the remaining 45.78% of the tranche.
